tests: Choosing a service for end-to-end request tracing and finding bottlenecks in microservices.
expected: AWS X-Ray — distributed tracing, service map, latency and errors per segment. Triggers: "trace requests across microservices", "latency bottlenecks", "end to end".
why_not: CloudWatch Logs Insights — log queries, no request-flow tracing; CloudTrail — API calls; Config — resource configuration.
